How does the 3-day free trial work?: How does the 3-day free trial work?
Start by uploading a CV or creating a ne: Start by uploading your CV or creating a new one, answer a few onboarding questions and see your CV Score. Then pick your next step and start the trial with a card to use the app — you won’t pay anything today. After 3 days, Weekly Pro renews automatically at the price shown at checkout unless you cancel before the trial ends.
How do I cancel my trial or subscription: How do I cancel my trial or subscription?
Sign in, open Pricing in the app, and us: Sign in, open Pricing in the app and use the billing portal to manage or cancel your subscription. You can cancel anytime — if you cancel before your trial ends, you won’t be charged. The portal shows your cancellation status and the date your access ends.

Why is my CV upload not working?: Why is my CV upload not working?
Upload a PDF or DOCX file that is not em: Upload a PDF or DOCX file that isn’t empty and is 20 MB or smaller. If the analysis doesn’t work, try again or create a new CV instead. Still stuck? Email us with the error message and file type.
How do I download my CV?: How do I download my CV?
Open your CV in the editor and use its e: Open your CV in the editor and use the export options to download a PDF or DOCX. Exports are included with an active trial or subscription. If an export doesn’t work, try again and email us with the format you chose and any error message.
